newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea department store officials to visit Japan.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea department store officials to visit Japan.

text.p: North Korean department store officials will visit Japan this week to buy presents for government and party officials for when de facto leader Kim Jong-il formally succeeds his father, Kyodo news agency reported on Monday.
Quoting unidentified Japanese government sources, Kyodo said the department store executives would arrive in Japan on Thursday for a one-month visit.
The North Koreans told a major Tokyo department store that there would be an inauguration ceremony for Kim Jong Il as early as September, Kyodo said.
The North Koreans would order "high-quality" underwear for several hundred people, Kyodo added.
A North Korean trading company also has contacted a Japanese company about ordering a large number of television sets with built-in video cassette players, Kyodo said.
Stalinist North Korea marks the end of the traditional three-year mourning period for late "Great Leader" Kim Il-sung on Tuesday.
Although the younger Kim has been in control of the government since his father's death, the posts of general secretary of the ruling Worker's Party and the state presidency have been left vacant.
Kyodo quoted the sources as saying it was certain that Kim would assume at least the top party post in September or October.
